description: This file defines the NotesProvider class, a ChangeNotifier that manages state for notes in a Flutter application. It interacts with a DatabaseService to load, add, update, and delete notes, and manages UI-related states such as layout, categories, loading, and error states.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier providing state management for notes, including loading, categories, layout, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the notes data, seeds sample notes if empty, and loads notes from the database.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the database based on the selected category.

methods.name: changeLayout
methods.description: Changes the layout of notes (list or grid).

methods.name: selectCategory
methods.description: Updates the current category and reloads notes accordingly.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: addOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new note or updates an existing one in the database, then reloads notes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from the database and reloads notes.
